sections.heading: WHY AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONICS TESTING IS IMPORTANT?
paragraphs: Following are the key benefits for testing of Electrical & Electronic components in vehicles:
bullets: Providing safety of automotive electrical & electronics Components by demonstrating compliance to applicable standards
Clarifying market access of electrical & electronic components by meeting relevant country standards (e.g. EU Low Voltage and Machinery Directives and EMC Directives etc)
Meeting end-user quality expectations for vehicle electrical & electronics Components.
